## What's Changed
* guard IsLocalResourceName against names missing documents segment (#1… by @cherylEnkidu in https://github.com/firebase/firebase-ios-sdk/pull/16435
* Removes unused Crashlytics integration with the now dep

- escape filenames properly in history/diff view
- bump Tomcat in Docker

- canonicalize path before checking project
- bump Tomcat in Docker to 10.1.60-jdk21

- allow Java 25
- classify projects with empty repository set correctly

- bump Tomcat version in Docker to 10.1.59-jdk21
- use logging for API induced configuration changes
- actually enforce Java 21 as minimum version in runtime checks

- allow dot character in the revision string (fixes Bitkeeper)
- restrict CORS HTTP headers to list of selected origins
  - introduced the `allowedOrigins` [webapp configuration tunable](https://github.com/oracle/opengrok/wiki/Webapp-configuration#configuration-tunables)

- support Java `record` keyword
- properly escape LDAP filter metacharcters in the `LdapFilter` authorization plugin
* **`verbose(false)` no longer enables verbose mode** — the flag was ignored, so calling it turned on curl verbose output (request headers, including `X-ClickHouse-Key`, on stderr)

* **Structured exceptions enriched** (#270, @sander-hash) — `DatabaseException::getServerVersion()` and `getServerStackTrace()` (populate with per-query `['stacktrace' => 1]`); reworked error-response parsing in `Statement`. The server stack trace is kept **out of** `getMessage()` — it is available only via the dedicated getter
* **ClickHouse 26.9 test matrix** — third container `clickhouse-26-9` (26.9.1.1629, port 8125), `phpunit-ch269.xml`, CI job PHP 8.1–8.4 × CH 26.9. Suites for 21.9 / 26.3 / 2
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/php-kchat/kchat/compare/2.0.4...2.0.5

## Fixed: the demo seed could delete your database
`scripts/seed_demo.py` builds the synthetic data used for the screenshots. It deleted any existing `backend/trading_journal.db` without asking, so running it after importing real trades would have wiped them. It now refuses when a database exists and changes nothing, unless you pass `--replace-database`. It is documented as a development tool only.
